name: Croque Madame
description: Buttered sourdough layered with Dijon, cooked ham, Gruyère and creamy béchamel, grilled until bubbling and topped with a fried egg, served with a sharp dressed salad.
instructions: Heat the grill to high and line a baking tray.
Melt 15 g butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in 15 g plain flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the semi-skimmed milk, then simmer for 2–3 minutes until the béchamel is smooth and thick enough to coat a spoon. Season with salt and black pepper.
Lightly toast both sides of the sourdough under the grill, then spread 5 g butter over the outward-facing sides.
Spread the Dijon mustard over one inward-facing side. Layer on the cooked ham and half of the Gruyère, then close the sandwich.
Put the sandwich on the lined tray. Spoon the béchamel over the top, scatter over the remaining Gruyère and grill for 3–5 minutes until deeply golden and bubbling.
Heat the remaining 5 g butter in a non-stick frying pan and fry the egg until the white is set but the yolk remains runny.
Toss the salad leaves with a squeeze of lemon, 1 tsp olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Top the grilled sandwich with the fried egg, finish with black pepper and serve immediately with the dressed salad.
